newsitem.title: ISRAEL: At least seven Palestinians drown in W.Bank floods.
newsitem.headline: At least seven Palestinians drown in W.Bank floods.

text.p: Eleven Palestinians were swept away in a flood after their mini-van plunged from a collapsing bridge near the West Bank town of Qalqilya, witnesses and the Israeli army said on Sunday.
The army said seven bodies were recovered by mid-day.

"The Israeli army, in coordination with Palestinian police and local residents, is continuing its search for Arab residents who were swept away with their vehicle in a flood south of Qalqilya," an army spokesman said.

Witnesses said a mini-van filled with Palestinian workers crashed on Saturday night into a valley flooded by two days of extremely heavy rains after a bridge collapsed. They said two managed to free themselves from the raging torrent but 11 were swept away with the vehicle.
The army and Palestinian civil rescue squads pulled seven bodies from the waters at the border between the West Bank and Israel by mid-day, the army said.

"(Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin) Netanyahu called (Palestinian) President Arafat this morning and expressed his sorrow at the death of the 11 workers who were swept away by torrents," Arafat aide Nabil Abu Rdaineh told Reuters.
The vehicle was swept away in a West Bank area under Israeli security control and Palestinian civilian jurisdiction.
